scope: The confirmed Culture Passport dining/bar records, plus new restaurant and Kansas City BBQ memories and high-value uncertain booking leads. The separate 178-candidate interview is an ongoing research queue, not 178 fully reverified places. 2026-10-25 integrity pass: Q House and Wildflower have award-qualified venue identities but reservation-only personal evidence, so their experience entries are archived with nonconfirmed status, excluded from public totals. Add two user-confirmed Denver visits in 2024 and 2026; new recognition only based on specific primary 2024 James Beard semifinalist documentation for Sắp Sửa; FiNO is an explicit nonaward user-selection, not a favorite designation. October 27, 2026 Union Station follow-up: repeated Pierpont's dining and Harvey's after-wedding goodbye brunch directly confirmed and explicitly selected. Pierpont's is linked by a 2011 Foundation editorial mention; Harvey's is a personal-memory exception. No new formal awards or exact visit dates.

criteria.qualifies: Documented Michelin Guide star, Bib Gourmand, Selected/recommended/historical Plate, or a James Beard winner/finalist/semifinalist for the restaurant or chef during their tenure there.
criteria.personal: User explicitly chose to preserve a personally meaningful venue regardless of award.
criteria.archive: Confirmed personal restaurant experience without verified qualifying honor, or a nonqualifying reservation/chef association.
criteria.timing: Preserve recognition date; do not assert the award was held on a meal date unless independently grounded.
criteria.visit: User confirmations and completed reservation records remain distinct. A reservation alone does not establish arrival.
criteria.officialConnection: Directly documented venue-specific James Beard Foundation / Michelin editorial features and program connections support the separate Official Foundation / Guide Connection tier; they are not awards.
